one_line: Pioneering Bengali physicist and biophysicist of Calcutta, exploring millimetre waves and plant responses.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s, medium height, slight but dignified build, with the calm bearing of a professor and inventor.
appearance.face: Oval face with high forehead, warm medium-brown complexion, straight brows, expressive almond-shaped eyes behind small round wire-rim spectacles, neatly trimmed moustache, slight lines of concentration, default expression thoughtful and gently determined.
appearance.hair: Thick, wavy, charcoal-black hair with a few subtle grey strands, brushed back from the forehead and softly puffed around the temples, no parting; wears a simple dark maroon Bengali-style cloth cap (thin soft topi) that sits snugly and low on the head.
appearance.costume: Late 19th–early 20th century Bengali bhadralok attire: a full-length, ankle-covering off‑white cotton panjabi kurta with a straight collar and long sleeves, worn over loose white cotton pyjama trousers; over this, a dark charcoal-grey woollen knee-length English-style frock coat with narrow lapels and three buttons, always worn open to reveal the kurta; a long, soft, deep-indigo cotton shawl draped from the left shoulder across the chest and wrapped once around the right forearm, edges bearing a subtle thin gold border; simple dark brown leather lace-up shoes; minimal jewellery—just a thin silver pocket-watch chain visible at the coat waist and a plain gold ring on the right hand.
appearance.signature: A compact brass-and-wood microwave demonstration setup: in his left hand he grips a polished wooden base holding a short cylindrical brass waveguide and a flared brass horn antenna, with a small crystal detector housing attached by a bent metal arm, while his right hand lightly rests on the apparatus as if adjusting it.

ref_desc: Jagadish Chandra Bose is a late-40s Bengali scientist with wavy charcoal-black hair, round spectacles, off-white kurta and pyjamas under a charcoal-grey frock coat, deep-indigo shawl, maroon cap, and a handheld brass-and-wood microwave horn and waveguide apparatus in brass-gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Jagadish Chandra Bose in late-19th-century Calcutta: a late-40s Bengali man of medium height and dignified build, with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, high forehead, round wire-rim glasses, neat moustache, and thick wavy charcoal-black hair brushed back with slight greying at the temples, topped by a simple dark maroon cloth cap. He wears an ankle-length off-white cotton panjabi kurta with long sleeves over loose white pyjama trousers, and a dark charcoal-grey woollen knee-length frock coat with narrow lapels hanging open to show the kurta. A long deep-indigo cotton shawl with a thin gold border is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and wrapped once around his right forearm. On his feet are plain dark brown leather lace-up shoes, and at his waist a subtle silver pocket-watch chain peeks from under the coat, with a plain gold ring on his right hand. His expression is thoughtful and resolute, eyes bright with curiosity. In his hands he presents his signature brass-and-wood microwave demonstration apparatus: a polished wooden base supporting a short cylindrical brass waveguide, a flared brass horn antenna pointing forward, and a small crystal detector housing on a bent metal arm, all rendered with clear metallic brass-gold highlights and precise mechanical detail. Show him front-facing, three-quarter, and back views to capture consistent hair volume, cap shape, shawl drape, coat length, and the exact look of the apparatus, using a palette dominated by off-white, charcoal grey, deep indigo, dark maroon, and brass gold.
